newsitem.title: MEXICO: GBM Atlantico 1996 net profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: GBM Atlantico 1996 net profit vs loss.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero GBM Atlantico SA de CV said on Tuesday it has registered a net profit in 1996 of 170 million pesos compared to a net loss of 136 million pesos in 1995.

The group said in a statement that the lion's share of profits came from its brokerage unit, which reported a net profit of 104 million pesos, followed by its leasing arm with 33 million pesos and its banking arm, Banco del Atlantico, with 26 million pesos.
It gave no other comparative figures.
Banco de Atlantico said it notched up its 26 million peso profit despite spending 1.4 billion pesos in restructuring costs and creating past-due loan reserves.
Coverage of its bad-loan portfolio rose to 92.3 percent while the bank's capitalisation ratio ended 1996 at 12.4 percent, 4.4 percentage points above the minimum required by law.
